== Biography ==


== Trivia ==
* Known for building unusual items such as {{ii|Redemption}} on {{ci|Olaf}} or {{ii|Doran's Blade}} on some other jungle champions.
* Good friend with [[Chovy]] and [[Lehends]].<ref>[https://www.fmkorea.com/index.php?mid=best&search_target=title&document_srl=2859344352&search_keyword=%EC%B9%B4%EB%82%98%EB%B9%84&page=2&listStyle=webzine#comment_] ''fmkorea.com''</ref> <ref>[https://www.fmkorea.com/index.php?mid=best&search_target=title&document_srl=2859344352&search_keyword=%EC%B9%B4%EB%82%98%EB%B9%84&page=2&listStyle=webzine#comment_] ''fmkorea.com''</ref>

=== Milestones ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on July 18, 2022.
** The 34th player and 5th (after [[Clearlove]], [[SofM]], [[Karsa]], and [[Tian]]) and fastest jungler to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on March 3, 2024.
** The 21st player and 1st jungler to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on April 20, 2025.
** The 16th player and 1st jungler to reach 2000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on March 14, 2024.
** The 28th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on May 1, 2025.
** The 20th player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on June 24, 2024.
** The 20th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 400 wins in the LPL on August 23, 2025.
** The 14th player to reach 400 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on March 1, 2025.
** The 31st player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on August 26, 2025.
** The 21st player to reach 600 games in the LPL.

=== Career Highlights and Awards ===
* MSI Champion x2 (2023, 2026)
* LPL Champion x5 (2020 Spring, 2022 Summer, 2023 Spring, 2023 Summer, 2025 Split 1)
* LPL Regular Season MVP x2 (2020 Spring, 2025 Split 2)
* LPL 1st All-Pro Team x7 (2020 Spring, 2020 Summer, 2022 Spring, 2023 Summer, 2024 Spring, 2025 Split 2, 2025 Split 3)
* LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x2 (2022 Summer, 2023 Spring)
* LPL 3rd All Pro Team x2 (2024 Summer, 2025 Split 1)
